content_of_post_to_comment:
I swear I've left it all, Instagram, Tumblr, Twitter, even TikTok. But Youtube is akin to Goliath for me in that my attempts to quit or even manage my addiction to it have all been in vain. It's not like I even NEED to watch it since I mostly just watch gaming videos or the news which I could get from online articles, the paper or TV instead.

Thus, I must ask of you all, if any of you were successful on this front, just how did you do it? How did you slay this enormous beast of a website that has kept me in this irremoveable trance for so many years?
comment: I had a similar problem with YouTube because it felt "useful" enough to justify every session. What helped was stopping the fight to quit completely and adding friction instead: logging out, removing the app, blocking recommendations, and deciding what I was actually going there for before opening it. The endless homepage was the real trap, not the videos I intentionally chose.
